title: HST M87 preview field-placement audit
question: Can the selected HST preview support morphology or jet claims when M87 lies at the frame boundary?
results: M87 emission reaches the bottom frame boundary at all tested thresholds

validation: Centroid, axis ratio, and edge contact are swept across five thresholds and five crop trims.
